title: The Academy as a common section glued from local necessity
claim: At Union scale, the repeated business relation is the concrete carrier of the mathematical gluing relation: receivers may disagree locally, but every receiver whose exact office lacks a qualified current character derives the same provider-neutral service category; the Academy becomes a common supplier only by repeatedly winning receiver-awarded market lots.

construction.localSection: one receiver-owned office epoch, receiver-owned incumbency census, and receiver-authored necessity attestation
construction.restriction: the attestation carries only the receiver's own evidence and authority state
construction.agreement: compatible attestations agree on the Academy service interface while preserving different offices, specializations, contexts, prices, refusals, and appointments
construction.gluedSection: LocallyGluedAcademyDemand names common service need, tenders, bids, and awards without creating global incumbency or management authority

organizationalReading: LMT → BOD → EO → operating enterprises is the responsibility-and-procurement chain. Receiver → market lot → competing bids → receiver award → winning provider is the officer-supply chain. UOA recursively contracts voluntary suppliers to make its own bid feasible.
fixedPoint: When the Academy can supply a currently qualified character for every admitted exact office demand, while every receiver can still independently refuse and the verifier finds no unowned reusable executor law, the professionalization relation is closed for that corpus epoch.
failureModes: counting a central census as local agreement
counting an Academy or EO offer as receiver acceptance
preselecting the Academy in the local derivation instead of making it compete
turning a repeatedly winning provider into a central appointing authority
equating a supplied character or ephemeral model call with an officer
hiding uncontracted or refused receivers inside a total-demand claim
